text: Oh gosh...It's extremely hard.\nI wonder how we can get inside...
Oh no way, no no no! A dragon again?!
You two, get outta there!\nI can't put on a show if you stay there!
I heard that you're in a battle. So I rushed here\nto return the favor. Killing this many monsters\nshouldn't be a problem for both of us. Let's go!
Hey, what about me?! Did you just ignore me?!
Oh, little Cule girl, you can fight too? I don't\nusually pay attention to my surroundings during a\nfight, so be careful not to let me step on you.
Dang...I can't believe a dragon is helping us.\nOh, I'm starting to sound like Gondrum, hate it...\nAlright! I'mma try to keep my distance from you!!
Now you can go inside. I think you should go now!
I'm too big. I might destroy Eldenbaum if I go\nfurther inside the trunk. I'll just stay here to\nstrengthen the defense...
